wf131_joint_close_out.verdict: MEASURED_PARTIAL_LIFT — Wf-124 P3 Ru seed=0 (30-epoch, multi-task + W₂ + L2 guard) test_pearson = 0.3091 — +0.102 lift over wf_pic50_margin_sweep BEST (0.207), still −0.263 below ridge baseline (0.572). Wf-131 P1 3-seed × 10-epoch mean = 0.260 ± 0.046 (consistent with shorter training). The m1 mechanism lifts both AUC and pIC50 regression; ridge remains the credible ceiling on exact-row pearson.

verdict: MEASURED_HONEST_NEGATIVE — D-MPNN does not beat ridge on exact-row pearson. Wf-124 P3 Ru seed=0 (30-epoch multi-task + W₂ + L2) lifts test_pearson to 0.3091 — the best MEASURED neural, +0.102 over wf_pic50_margin_sweep BEST (0.207), but still −0.263 below ridge (0.572). Margin sweep identified 0.5 as best (down-shift from 1.0 default). Honest paper framing: ridge remains the credible ceiling; neural adds value via AUC (Ru 0.7123 → 0.7613 in Wf-124 P3) and bound-aware accuracy (ba_acc=1.0 at margin≥0.5).
